description: A single day in the month grid (or week strip). Shows the date number and a row of up to 3 markers that distinguish, at a glance, whether the day had REAL spending/income (solid markers) vs an UPCOMING unpaid bill (hollow ring marker).

day.description: Day of month, or null for grid padding

hasActualSpending.description: Real expense transaction or paid bill on this day

hasUpcomingBill.description: An unpaid/projected bill is due this day

hasOverdueBill.description: Upcoming bill is overdue — hollow ring turns red

overflow.description: More than 3 markers — render a '+' glyph

states.selected: filled colors.primary circle, white number, cell bg rgba(124,58,237,0.18)

accessibility.label: {weekday} {day}. {hasActualSpending ? 'spending' : ''} {hasIncome ? 'income' : ''} {hasUpcomingBill ? 'bill due' : ''}
accessibility.hint: Double tap to view this day
accessibility.note: Solid vs hollow marker shape carries the actual/projected meaning independent of color.

developerNotes: Cap markers at 3, then show '+'. Tappable area must be >= 44pt even though the visible circle is ~32px.
